854057.name: COQ3
854057.summary: Enables 3-demethylubiquinol 3-O-methyltransferase activity and polyprenyldihydroxybenzoate methyltransferase activity. Involved in ubiquinone biosynthetic process. Located in mitochondrial inner membrane. Is extrinsic component of mitochondrial inner membrane. Orthologous to human COQ3 (coenzyme Q3, methyltransferase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

854058.name: HMI1
854058.summary: Enables 3'-5' DNA helicase activity. Involved in mitochondrial DNA metabolic process. Located in mitochondrial matrix. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

854061.name: YPQ1
854061.summary: Enables L-lysine transmembrane transporter activity. Involved in L-lysine transmembrane import into vacuole and basic amino acid transmembrane export from vacuole. Located in fungal-type vacuole membrane. Orthologous to human SLC66A1 (solute carrier family 66 member 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

854063.name: MSH2
854063.summary: Enables ATP binding activity; ATP hydrolysis activity; and DNA secondary structure binding activity. Contributes to DNA binding activity. Involved in DNA metabolic process and silent mating-type cassette heterochromatin formation. Located in nuclear chromosome. Part of MutSalpha complex and MutSbeta complex. Used to study Lynch syndrome (multiple); cancer (multiple); and ovarian disease (multiple). Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in several diseases, including Lynch syndrome (multiple); gastrointestinal system cancer (multiple); lung cancer (multiple); mismatch repair cancer syndrome; and transitional cell carcinoma. Orthologous to human MSH2 (mutS homolog 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

854068.name: ADH1
854068.summary: Enables identical protein binding activity; melatonin binding activity; and oxidoreductase activity, acting on the CH-OH group of donors, NAD or NADP as acceptor. Involved in amino acid catabolic process to alcohol via Ehrlich pathway and pyruvate fermentation to ethanol. Located in cytoplasm. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

854079.name: MDM20
854079.summary: Contributes to protein-N-terminal amino-acid acetyltransferase activity. Involved in several processes, including N-terminal peptidyl-methionine acetylation; mitochondrion inheritance; and regulation of actin cytoskeleton organization. Part of NatB complex. Orthologous to human NAA25 (N-alpha-acetyltransferase 25, NatB auxiliary subunit). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

854083.name: SDH5
854083.summary: Involved in several processes, including aerobic respiration; mitochondrial respiratory chain complex II assembly; and protein flavinylation. Located in mitochondrion. Is active in mitochondrial matrix. Used to study paraganglioma. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in pheochromocytoma/paraganglioma syndrome 2. Orthologous to human SDHAF2 (succinate dehydrogenase complex assembly factor 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

854086.name: HST1
854086.summary: Enables histone deacetylase activity, NAD-dependent. Involved in several processes, including negative regulation of meiotic nuclear division; negative regulation of mitotic recombination; and silent mating-type cassette heterochromatin formation. Located in nucleus. Part of Set3 complex. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Huntington's disease. Orthologous to human SIRT1 (sirtuin 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

854087.name: RTG1
854087.summary: Enables DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. Involved in several processes, including cellular response to oleic acid; mitochondria-nucleus signaling pathway; and peroxisome fission. Located in cytoplasm and nucleus. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

854089.name: INP54
854089.summary: Enables phosphatidylinositol-4,5-bisphosphate 5-phosphatase activity. Involved in phosphatidylinositol dephosphorylation. Located in endoplasmic reticulum. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

854105.name: SPE2
854105.summary: Enables adenosylmethionine decarboxylase activity. Involved in spermidine biosynthetic process and spermine biosynthetic process. Located in cytoplasm and nucleus. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in lung non-small cell carcinoma. Orthologous to human AMD1 (adenosylmethionine decarboxylase 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

854118.name: RPP2A
854118.summary: A structural constituent of ribosome. Involved in cytoplasmic translation. Part of cytosolic large ribosomal subunit. Orthologous to human RPLP2 (ribosomal protein lateral stalk subunit P2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

854133.name: LAG2
854133.summary: Involved in negative regulation of protein ubiquitination. Located in mitochondrion. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

854139.name: TAT2
854139.description: aromatic amino acid transmembrane transporter TAT2
854139.otheraliases: YOL020W, HPG2, LTG3, SAB2, SCM2, TAP2
854139.otherdesignations: aromatic amino acid transmembrane transporter TAT2
854139.nomenclaturename: aromatic amino acid transmembrane transporter TAT2
854139.summary: Enables high-affinity tryptophan transmembrane transporter activity. Involved in tryptophan transport. Located in plasma membrane. Is active in eisosome and plasma membrane raft. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

854149.name: HRD1
854149.summary: Enables identical protein binding activity and ubiquitin protein ligase activity. Involved in several processes, including endoplasmic reticulum unfolded protein response; protein catabolic process; and protein ubiquitination. Located in endoplasmic reticulum membrane. Part of Hrd1p ubiquitin ligase ERAD-L complex and Hrd1p ubiquitin ligase ERAD-M complex. Used to study alpha 1-antitrypsin deficiency. Orthologous to human SYVN1 (synoviolin 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

854154.name: COQ10
854154.summary: Enables molecular carrier activity and ubiquinone binding activity. Involved in ubiquinone biosynthetic process. Located in mitochondrial inner membrane. Orthologous to several human genes including COQ10A (coenzyme Q10A). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

854156.name: TOP1
854156.summary: Enables DNA topoisomerase type I (single strand cut, ATP-independent) activity. Involved in several processes, including DNA-templated transcription; chromosome organization; and regulation of gene expression. Located in nucleolus. Is active in mitochondrion and nucleus. Used to study cancer. Orthologous to human TOP1 (DNA topoisomerase I) and TOP1MT (DNA topoisomerase I mitochondrial). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

854163.name: ALG6
854163.summary: Enables dolichyl pyrophosphate Man9GlcNAc2 alpha-1,3-glucosyltransferase activity. Involved in aerobic respiration and dolichol-linked oligosaccharide biosynthetic process. Located in endoplasmic reticulum membrane. Used to study congenital disorder of glycosylation type I. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in congenital disorder of glycosylation Ic. Orthologous to human ALG6 (ALG6 alpha-1,3-glucosyltransferase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

854168.name: SGT2
854168.summary: Enables heat shock protein binding activity; identical protein binding activity; and molecular adaptor activity. Involved in post-translational protein targeting to endoplasmic reticulum membrane and response to heat. Located in cytoplasm. Part of TRC complex. Orthologous to human SGTA (small glutamine rich tetratricopeptide repeat co-chaperone alpha) and SGTB (small glutamine rich tetratricopeptide repeat co-chaperone beta). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

854182.name: PET127
854182.summary: Involved in mitochondrial RNA 5'-end processing. Located in mitochondrial envelope. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

854198.name: EXO1
854198.summary: Enables 5'-3' exonuclease activity and 5'-flap endonuclease activity. Involved in DNA metabolic process and mitotic G2/M transition checkpoint. Located in cytoplasm and nucleus. Used to study primary ovarian insufficiency. Orthologous to human EXO1 (exonuclease 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

854201.name: PEP12
854201.summary: Enables SNAP receptor activity. Involved in macroautophagy; vacuolar transport; and vacuole inheritance. Located in Golgi apparatus and endosome. Orthologous to several human genes including STX12 (syntaxin 12). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

854202.name: CYC2
854202.summary: Enables oxidoreductase activity. Involved in cytochrome c-heme linkage and mitochondrial membrane organization. Located in mitochondrial inner membrane. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

854203.name: HIR2
854203.summary: Enables transcription corepressor activity. Contributes to DNA binding activity and nucleosome binding activity. Involved in chromatin remodeling; negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription; and regulation of chromatin organization. Located in cytosol and nucleus. Part of HIR complex. Orthologous to human HIRA (histone cell cycle regulator). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

854208.name: WHI2
854208.summary: Enables protein phosphatase binding activity. Contributes to phosphoprotein phosphatase activity. Involved in several processes, including negative regulation of TORC1 signaling; positive regulation of G1 to G0 transition; and regulation of gene expression. Located in cell periphery. Part of phosphatase complex. Used to study progressive myoclonus epilepsy 3. Orthologous to human GPATCH1 (G-patch domain containing 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

854217.name: TMC1
854217.summary: Predicted to enable zinc ion binding activity. Involved in cellular response to arsenic-containing substance and cellular response to misfolded protein. Located in nucleus. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

854220.name: VHS3
854220.summary: Enables identical protein binding activity and protein phosphatase inhibitor activity. Contributes to phosphopantothenoylcysteine decarboxylase activity. Involved in coenzyme A biosynthetic process and intracellular monoatomic cation homeostasis. Part of CoA-synthesizing protein complex and phosphopantothenoylcysteine decarboxylase complex. Used to study dilated cardiomyopathy. Orthologous to human PPCDC (phosphopantothenoylcysteine decarboxylase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

854227.name: CKA2
854227.summary: Enables protein serine/threonine kinase activity. Involved in several processes, including donor selection; nucleolar large rRNA transcription by RNA polymerase I; and regulation of DNA-templated transcription. Part of UTP-C complex and protein kinase CK2 complex. Orthologous to human CSNK2A1 (casein kinase 2 alpha 1); CSNK2A2 (casein kinase 2 alpha 2); and CSNK2A3 (casein kinase 2 alpha 3). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

854231.name: CYT1
854231.summary: Enables quinol-cytochrome-c reductase activity. Involved in mitochondrial electron transport, ubiquinol to cytochrome c. Located in mitochondrial inner membrane. Part of respiratory chain complex III. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in mitochondrial complex III deficiency nuclear type 6. Orthologous to human CYC1 (cytochrome c1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

854234.name: VAM10
854234.summary: Involved in vacuole fusion, non-autophagic. Predicted to be located in fungal-type vacuole membrane. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

854235.name: VPS5
854235.summary: Enables phosphatidylinositol-3-phosphate binding activity. Contributes to cargo adaptor activity. Involved in protein retention in Golgi apparatus and retrograde transport, endosome to Golgi. Located in cytosol and endosome. Part of retromer, tubulation complex. Orthologous to human SNX1 (sorting nexin 1) and SNX2 (sorting nexin 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

854236.name: GYP1
854236.summary: Enables GTPase activator activity. Involved in vesicle-mediated transport. Located in Golgi apparatus. Orthologous to human TBC1D22A (TBC1 domain family member 22A) and TBC1D22B (TBC1 domain family member 22B). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

854252.name: OST3
854252.summary: Enables dolichyl-diphosphooligosaccharide-protein glycotransferase activity and protein-disulfide reductase activity. Involved in protein N-linked glycosylation and protein O-linked glycosylation via mannose. Located in membrane. Part of oligosaccharyltransferase complex. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in X-linked immunodeficiency with magnesium defect, Epstein-Barr virus infection, and neoplasia; autosomal recessive intellectual developmental disorder 7; and congenital disorder of glycosylation Icc. Orthologous to human MAGT1 (magnesium transporter 1) and TUSC3 (tumor suppressor candidate 3). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

854256.name: VPS21
854256.summary: Enables GTPase activity. Involved in several processes, including multivesicular body assembly; reticulophagy; and vacuolar transport. Located in early endosome and late endosome. Orthologous to human RAB5A (RAB5A, member RAS oncogene family); RAB5B (RAB5B, member RAS oncogene family); and RAB5C (RAB5C, member RAS oncogene family). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

854257.name: PTC5
854257.summary: Enables [pyruvate dehydrogenase (acetyl-transferring)]-phosphatase activity. Involved in peptidyl-serine dephosphorylation. Located in mitochondrial intermembrane space. Is active in peroxisome. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in obesity and pyruvate decarboxylase deficiency. Orthologous to human PDP1 (pyruvate dehydrogenase phosphatase catalytic subunit 1) and PDP2 (pyruvate dehydrogenase phosphatase catalytic subunit 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

854263.name: RPS7A
854263.summary: Predicted to be a structural constituent of ribosome. Involved in ribosome biogenesis. Part of small-subunit processome. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Diamond-Blackfan anemia 8. Orthologous to human RPS7 (ribosomal protein S7). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

854267.name: CRC1
854267.summary: Enables carnitine:O-acyl-L-carnitine antiporter activity. Involved in carnitine transmembrane transport and fatty acid metabolic process. Located in mitochondrial inner membrane. Used to study lipid metabolism disorder. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in carnitine-acylcarnitine translocase deficiency. Orthologous to human SLC25A20 (solute carrier family 25 member 20). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

854268.name: RAS1
854268.summary: Enables GTPase activity. Involved in adenylate cyclase-activating G protein-coupled receptor signaling pathway; positive regulation of adenylate cyclase activity; and protein localization to bud neck. Located in plasma membrane. Used to study Costello syndrome; colorectal cancer; and urinary bladder cancer. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Noonan syndrome 12. Orthologous to human RRAS (RAS related) and RRAS2 (RAS related 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

854273.name: VAM3
854273.summary: Enables SNAP receptor activity. Involved in several processes, including macroautophagy; vacuolar calcium ion homeostasis; and vacuole fusion. Located in autophagosome membrane and fungal-type vacuole membrane. Part of SNARE complex. Orthologous to human STX7 (syntaxin 7). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

854274.name: RGS2
854274.summary: Enables GTPase activator activity. Involved in adenylate cyclase-modulating G protein-coupled receptor signaling pathway. Located in cytoplasm and nucleus. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in colorectal adenocarcinoma and essential hypertension. Orthologous to several human genes including RGS5 (regulator of G protein signaling 5). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

854276.name: INP53
854276.summary: Enables phosphatidylinositol phosphate phosphatase activity. Involved in phosphatidylinositol dephosphorylation. Located in actin cortical patch and membrane. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Parkinson's disease; Parkinson's disease 20; and developmental and epileptic encephalopathy 53. Orthologous to human SYNJ1 (synaptojanin 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

854283.name: RPO31
854283.description: DNA-directed RNA polymerase III core subunit RPO31
854283.otherdesignations: DNA-directed RNA polymerase III core subunit RPO31
854283.nomenclaturename: DNA-directed RNA polymerase III core subunit RPO31
854283.summary: Contributes to DNA-directed RNA polymerase activity. Involved in tRNA transcription by RNA polymerase III; termination of RNA polymerase III transcription; and transcription initiation at RNA polymerase III promoter. Part of RNA polymerase III complex. Used to study hypomyelinating leukodystrophy and hypomyelinating leukodystrophy 7. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Wiedemann-Rautenstrauch syndrome and hypomyelinating leukodystrophy 7. Orthologous to human POLR3A (RNA polymerase III subunit A). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

854284.name: RPT5
854284.description: proteasome regulatory particle base subunit RPT5
854284.otherdesignations: proteasome regulatory particle base subunit RPT5
854284.nomenclaturename: proteasome regulatory particle base subunit RPT5
854284.summary: Predicted to enable ATP hydrolysis activity and proteasome-activating activity. Involved in positive regulation of RNA polymerase II transcription preinitiation complex assembly; proteasome regulatory particle assembly; and proteasome-mediated ubiquitin-dependent protein catabolic process. Part of proteasome regulatory particle, base subcomplex. Orthologous to human PSMC3 (proteasome 26S subunit, ATPase 3). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

854292.name: CAT5
854292.summary: Predicted to enable 3-demethoxyubiquinone 3-hydroxylase (NADH) activity. Involved in ubiquinone biosynthetic process. Located in mitochondrial inner membrane. Used to study primary coenzyme Q10 deficiency 8. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in autosomal recessive distal hereditary motor neuronopathy 9 and primary coenzyme Q10 deficiency 8. Orthologous to human COQ7 (coenzyme Q7, hydroxylase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

854295.name: ADE2
854295.summary: Enables phosphoribosylaminoimidazole carboxylase activity. Involved in purine nucleobase metabolic process. Located in cytoplasm. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

854301.name: EFT1
854301.summary: Enables several functions, including identical protein binding activity; protein-folding chaperone binding activity; and translation elongation factor activity. Involved in maintenance of translational fidelity; positive regulation of translational elongation; and translational elongation. Is active in cytosol. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in glaucoma; spinocerebellar ataxia 26; and stomach cancer. Orthologous to human EEF2 (eukaryotic translation elongation factor 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

854303.name: IDH2
854303.summary: Contributes to isocitrate dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity. Involved in isocitrate metabolic process and tricarboxylic acid cycle. Located in mitochondrion. Part of isocitrate dehydrogenase complex (NAD+). Used to study early infantile epileptic encephalopathy. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in retinitis pigmentosa 90. Orthologous to human IDH3A (isocitrate dehydrogenase (NAD(+)) 3 catalytic subunit alpha). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

854307.name: SFL1
854307.summary: Enables DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific; RNA polymerase II cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity; and RNA polymerase II-specific DNA-binding transcription factor binding activity. Involved in negative regulation of growth of unicellular organism as a thread of attached cells and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Located in nucleus. Orthologous to human HSF5 (heat shock transcription factor 5). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

854310.name: LSC1
854310.summary: Contributes to succinate-CoA ligase (ADP-forming) activity. Involved in succinyl-CoA metabolic process. Located in mitochondrial nucleoid. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in mitochondrial DNA depletion syndrome 9. Orthologous to human SUCLG1 (succinate-CoA ligase GDP/ADP-forming subunit alpha). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

854351.name: SYC1
854351.summary: Predicted to enable RNA binding activity. Involved in negative regulation of mRNA 3'-end processing. Located in nucleus. Part of mRNA cleavage and polyadenylation specificity factor complex. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

854372.name: MCA1
854372.summary: Enables calcium-dependent cysteine-type endopeptidase activity. Involved in apoptotic process and protein quality control for misfolded or incompletely synthesized proteins. Located in cytosol and nucleus. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

854380.name: GEP3
854380.summary: Enables mitochondrial ribosome binding activity. Involved in maturation of SSU-rRNA. Located in mitochondrial inner membrane. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

854384.name: NPT1
854384.summary: Enables nicotinate phosphoribosyltransferase activity. Involved in nicotinate nucleotide salvage; rDNA heterochromatin formation; and subtelomeric heterochromatin formation. Located in nucleus. Orthologous to human NAPRT (nicotinate phosphoribosyltransferase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

854406.name: MKK1
854406.summary: Enables protein kinase activity. Involved in cell integrity MAPK cascade; pexophagy; and regulation of fungal-type cell wall organization. Located in several cellular components, including cellular bud neck; cellular bud tip; and mating projection tip. Orthologous to human MAP2K5 (mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase 5). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

854409.name: RPL33B
854409.summary: A structural constituent of ribosome. Involved in cytoplasmic translation. Part of cytosolic large ribosomal subunit. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Diamond-Blackfan anemia 5. Orthologous to human RPL35A (ribosomal protein L35a). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

854412.name: HES1
854412.summary: Enables oxysterol binding activity and sterol transfer activity. Involved in several processes, including maintenance of cell polarity; piecemeal microautophagy of the nucleus; and sterol transport. Located in cellular bud neck and fungal-type vacuole membrane. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in autosomal dominant nonsyndromic deafness 67. Orthologous to human OSBPL2 (oxysterol binding protein like 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

854423.name: APC5
854423.summary: Contributes to ubiquitin protein ligase activity. Involved in anaphase-promoting complex-dependent catabolic process; chromatin organization; and protein ubiquitination. Located in nucleus. Part of anaphase-promoting complex. Orthologous to human ANAPC5 (anaphase promoting complex subunit 5). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

854432.name: HNT3
854432.summary: Enables DNA 5'-adenosine monophosphate hydrolase activity. Involved in DNA damage response. Located in cytoplasm and nucleus. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in early-onset ataxia with oculomotor apraxia and hypoalbuminemia and olivopontocerebellar atrophy. Orthologous to human APTX (aprataxin). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

854440.name: PNT1
854440.summary: Involved in protein insertion into mitochondrial inner membrane from matrix. Located in mitochondrial inner membrane. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

854444.name: VPH1
854444.description: H(+)-transporting V0 sector ATPase subunit a
854444.otherdesignations: H(+)-transporting V0 sector ATPase subunit a
854444.nomenclaturename: H(+)-transporting V0 sector ATPase subunit a
854444.summary: Enables phosphatidylinositol-3,5-bisphosphate binding activity. Contributes to proton-transporting ATPase activity, rotational mechanism. Involved in several processes, including cellular hyperosmotic response; cellular response to alkaline pH; and vacuolar acidification. Acts upstream of or within protein localization to vacuolar membrane. Located in fungal-type vacuole membrane and membrane raft. Part of vacuolar proton-transporting V-type ATPase, V0 domain. Used to study autosomal recessive osteopetrosis 1 and renal tubular acidosis. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in autosomal recessive cutis laxa type IIA; autosomal recessive osteopetrosis 1; developmental and epileptic encephalopathy 104; renal tubular acidosis (multiple); and wrinkly skin syndrome. Orthologous to several human genes including ATP6V0A1 (ATPase H+ transporting V0 subunit a1); ATP6V0A2 (ATPase H+ transporting V0 subunit a2); and ATP6V0A4 (ATPase H+ transporting V0 subunit a4). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

854462.name: MPD1
854462.summary: Enables protein disulfide isomerase activity and protein-disulfide reductase (glutathione) activity. Involved in protein folding. Located in endoplasmic reticulum and fungal-type vacuole. Orthologous to human PDIA6 (protein disulfide isomerase family A member 6). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

854470.name: UAF30
854470.summary: Enables RNA polymerase I cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity and RNA polymerase I general transcription initiation factor activity. Involved in chromatin organization; nucleolar large rRNA transcription by RNA polymerase I; and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase I. Located in nucleolus. Part of RNA polymerase I upstream activating factor complex. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

854480.name: ISW2
854480.summary: Enables DNA binding activity; DNA translocase activity; and chromatin binding activity. Involved in cellular response to pheromone; regulation of gene expression; and termination of RNA polymerase II transcription. Located in nuclear microtubule. Part of CHRAC. Orthologous to human SMARCA1 (SNF2 related chromatin remodeling ATPase 1) and SMARCA5 (SNF2 related chromatin remodeling ATPase 5). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

854482.name: RRG7
854482.summary: Located in mitochondrion. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

854483.name: MCH5
854483.summary: Enables riboflavin transmembrane transporter activity. Involved in riboflavin transport. Located in plasma membrane. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in cataract 47. Orthologous to several human genes including SLC16A11 (solute carrier family 16 member 11); SLC16A12 (solute carrier family 16 member 12); and SLC16A5 (solute carrier family 16 member 5). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

854489.name: RPL20B
854489.summary: Predicted to be a structural constituent of ribosome. Predicted to be involved in cytoplasmic translation. Part of cytosolic large ribosomal subunit. Orthologous to human RPL18A (ribosomal protein L18a). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

854500.name: LDB19
854500.summary: Enables ubiquitin protein ligase binding activity. Involved in several processes, including cellular response to amino acid stimulus; positive regulation of receptor internalization; and ubiquitin-dependent endocytosis. Located in Golgi trans cisterna; cytosol; and plasma membrane. Orthologous to several human genes including ARRDC1 (arrestin domain containing 1); ARRDC2 (arrestin domain containing 2); and ARRDC3 (arrestin domain containing 3). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

854511.name: MRS2
854511.summary: Enables cardiolipin binding activity and magnesium ion transmembrane transporter activity. Involved in mitochondrial magnesium ion transmembrane transport. Located in mitochondrion. Is active in mitochondrial inner membrane. Used to study Barth syndrome. Orthologous to human MRS2 (magnesium transporter MRS2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

854532.name: MNE1
854532.summary: Involved in Group I intron splicing and mitochondrial mRNA processing. Located in mitochondrial matrix. Part of ribonucleoprotein complex. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

854539.name: SNX3
854539.summary: Enables phosphatidylinositol-3-phosphate binding activity. Involved in intracellular protein localization and late endosome to Golgi transport. Located in cytosol and endosome. Part of protein-lipid complex. Orthologous to human SNX12 (sorting nexin 12) and SNX3 (sorting nexin 3). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

854542.name: PDE2
854542.summary: Enables 3',5'-cyclic-AMP phosphodiesterase activity. Involved in adenylate cyclase-activating G protein-coupled receptor signaling pathway. Located in cytoplasm and nucleus. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in several diseases, including acrodysostosis; alcohol dependence; autosomal dominant nonsyndromic deafness 74; primary pigmented nodular adrenocortical disease 3; and stroke. Orthologous to several human genes including PDE4A (phosphodiesterase 4A); PDE4B (phosphodiesterase 4B); and PDE4C (phosphodiesterase 4C). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

854549.name: SCP1
854549.summary: Enables actin filament binding activity and protein-macromolecule adaptor activity. Involved in actin filament organization. Located in actin cortical patch. Orthologous to several human genes including TAGLN2 (transgelin 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

854551.name: RPS12
854551.summary: A structural constituent of ribosome. Involved in maintenance of translational fidelity; maturation of SSU-rRNA; and ribosomal small subunit assembly. Located in cytoplasm. Part of cytosolic small ribosomal subunit. Orthologous to human RPS12 (ribosomal protein S12). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

854553.name: GPB1
854553.summary: Enables GTPase activating protein binding activity and cAMP-dependent protein kinase inhibitor activity. Involved in several processes, including invasive growth in response to glucose limitation; pseudohyphal growth; and regulation of Ras protein signal transduction. Located in plasma membrane. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

854556.name: ALD4
854556.summary: Enables aldehyde dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity. Involved in NADPH regeneration; acetate biosynthetic process; and ethanol metabolic process. Acts upstream of or within lipid metabolic process. Located in mitochondrial nucleoid. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in several diseases, including alcohol dependence; alcohol use disorder; artery disease (multiple); diabetes mellitus (multiple); and liver disease (multiple). Orthologous to several human genes including ALDH1A1 (aldehyde dehydrogenase 1 family member A1); ALDH1A2 (aldehyde dehydrogenase 1 family member A2); and ALDH1A3 (aldehyde dehydrogenase 1 family member A3). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

854651.name: GUT2
854651.summary: Enables glycerol-3-phosphate dehydrogenase (quinone) activity. Involved in glycerol metabolic process. Located in mitochondrial outer membrane. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in type 2 diabetes mellitus. Orthologous to human GPD2 (glycerol-3-phosphate dehydrogenase 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

854670.name: OM45
854670.summary: Located in mitochondrial outer membrane. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

854676.name: ASG1
854676.summary: Enables sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Located in nucleus. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

854681.name: KGD1
854681.summary: Predicted to enable oxoglutarate dehydrogenase (succinyl-transferring) activity. Involved in 2-oxoglutarate metabolic process. Located in mitochondrial nucleoid. Part of oxoglutarate dehydrogenase complex. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in oxoglutarate dehydrogenase deficiency. Orthologous to human OGDH (oxoglutarate dehydrogenase) and OGDHL (oxoglutarate dehydrogenase L). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

854684.name: POG1
854684.summary: Enables RNA polymerase II cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Involved in positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II; re-entry into mitotic cell cycle after pheromone arrest; and sporulation resulting in formation of a cellular spore. Located in chromatin. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

854693.name: SDP1
854693.description: mitogen-activated protein kinase tyrosine protein phosphatase SDP1
854693.otherdesignations: mitogen-activated protein kinase tyrosine protein phosphatase SDP1
854693.nomenclaturename: mitogen-activated protein kinase tyrosine protein phosphatase SDP1
854693.summary: Enables MAP kinase tyrosine phosphatase activity and MAP kinase tyrosine/serine/threonine phosphatase activity. Involved in cell integrity MAPK cascade. Located in cytoplasm and nucleus. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in pulmonary tuberculosis. Orthologous to several human genes including DUSP14 (dual specificity phosphatase 14); DUSP18 (dual specificity phosphatase 18); and DUSP21 (dual specificity phosphatase 21). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

854703.name: DPH1
854703.summary: Enables 4 iron, 4 sulfur cluster binding activity. Contributes to 2-(3-amino-3-carboxypropyl)histidine synthase activity. Involved in protein histidyl modification to diphthamide. Located in cytoplasm. Part of 2-(3-amino-3-carboxypropyl)histidine synthase complex. Used to study diphthamide deficiency syndrome. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in diphthamide deficiency syndrome 1. Orthologous to human DPH1 (diphthamide biosynthesis 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

854709.name: FMC1
854709.summary: Involved in macroautophagy and mitochondrial proton-transporting ATP synthase complex assembly. Located in mitochondrial matrix. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

854713.name: PRK1
854713.summary: Enables protein serine/threonine kinase activity. Involved in actin cortical patch assembly and negative regulation of cellular component organization. Located in actin cortical patch. Orthologous to several human genes including BMP2K (BMP2 inducible kinase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

854714.name: LYS12
854714.summary: Enables homoisocitrate dehydrogenase activity. Predicted to be involved in L-lysine biosynthetic process. Located in mitochondrion. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

854725.name: SDS3
854725.summary: Contributes to histone deacetylase activity. Involved in several processes, including cell adhesion involved in single-species biofilm formation; regulation of gene expression; and regulation of invasive growth in response to glucose limitation. Located in cytosol and nucleus. Part of Rpd3L complex. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

854733.name: RCI37
854733.summary: Located in mitochondrion. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

854734.name: SEC28
854734.summary: Enables promoter-specific chromatin binding activity. Involved in endoplasmic reticulum to Golgi vesicle-mediated transport; late endosome to vacuole transport via multivesicular body sorting pathway; and vesicle coating. Part of COPI vesicle coat. Orthologous to human COPE (coat protein complex I subunit epsilon). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

854737.name: SPO22
854737.summary: Involved in positive regulation of protein sumoylation and regulation of synaptonemal complex assembly. Located in nucleus. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in X-linked spermatogenic failure 2. Orthologous to human TEX11 (testis expressed 11). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

854741.name: RPS24B
854741.summary: Predicted to be a structural constituent of ribosome. Involved in maturation of SSU-rRNA from tricistronic rRNA transcript (SSU-rRNA, 5.8S rRNA, LSU-rRNA). Predicted to be located in cytosol. Predicted to be part of cytosolic small ribosomal subunit. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Diamond-blackfan anemia 3. Orthologous to human RPS24 (ribosomal protein S24). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

854744.name: RNR3
854744.summary: Contributes to ribonucleoside-diphosphate reductase activity, thioredoxin disulfide as acceptor. Involved in deoxyribonucleotide biosynthetic process. Located in cytoplasm. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in chronic progressive external ophthalmoplegia. Orthologous to human RRM1 (ribonucleotide reductase catalytic subunit M1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

854745.name: FIS1
854745.summary: Predicted to enable lipid binding activity and molecular adaptor activity. Involved in mitochondrial fission; peroxisome fission; and positive regulation of mitochondrial fission. Located in mitochondrial outer membrane and peroxisome. Orthologous to human FIS1 (fission, mitochondrial 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

854759.name: RPL34B
854759.summary: Predicted to be a structural constituent of ribosome. Predicted to be involved in cytoplasmic translation. Part of cytosolic large ribosomal subunit. Orthologous to human RPL34 (ribosomal protein L34). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

854761.name: PCL7
854761.summary: Enables cyclin-dependent protein serine/threonine kinase regulator activity. Involved in regulation of glycogen biosynthetic process; regulation of glycogen catabolic process; and regulation of protein stability. Located in nucleus. Part of cyclin-dependent protein kinase holoenzyme complex. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

854772.name: TED1
854772.summary: Predicted to enable hydrolase activity. Involved in endoplasmic reticulum to Golgi vesicle-mediated transport. Located in endoplasmic reticulum. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

854778.name: BCY1
854778.description: cAMP-dependent protein kinase regulatory subunit BCY1
854778.otherdesignations: cAMP-dependent protein kinase regulatory subunit BCY1
854778.nomenclaturename: cAMP-dependent protein kinase regulatory subunit BCY1
854778.summary: Enables cAMP-dependent protein kinase inhibitor activity and identical protein binding activity. Involved in several processes, including cellular response to glucose starvation; negative regulation of Ras protein signal transduction; and protein localization to bud neck. Located in several cellular components, including chromatin; nucleus; and plasma membrane. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in congestive heart failure. Orthologous to several human genes including PRKAR2A (protein kinase cAMP-dependent type II regulatory subunit alpha) and PRKAR2B (protein kinase cAMP-dependent type II regulatory subunit beta). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

854794.name: RPL2B
854794.summary: A structural constituent of ribosome. Involved in cytoplasmic translation. Part of cytosolic large ribosomal subunit. Used to study Diamond-Blackfan anemia. Orthologous to human RPL8 (ribosomal protein L8). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

854811.name: YIA6
854811.summary: Enables NAD transmembrane transporter activity. Involved in mitochondrial NAD transmembrane transport and pyruvate import into mitochondria. Located in mitochondrion. Orthologous to human SLC25A32 (solute carrier family 25 member 32). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

854815.name: INP51
854815.summary: Enables phosphatidylinositol-4,5-bisphosphate 5-phosphatase activity. Involved in phosphatidylinositol dephosphorylation. Located in cytoplasm and membrane. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Parkinson's disease; Parkinson's disease 20; and developmental and epileptic encephalopathy 53. Orthologous to human SYNJ1 (synaptojanin 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]
